gen-fs-oswald-gf-elms-sans: Oswald packs its rows of text tight and confident, while Elms Sans draws a ballpoint-plain line with a visible gap in every s. One stands tall and loud, the other relaxed.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans: Tightly knit rows give Oswald a strong, confident stance, and Encode Sans lets its c stay clearly apart from o. Loud on top, tidy below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Encode Sans Expanded reads as a plain sans with its c tips pulled well apart, friendly and wide. Over many lines it would stay approachable, while Oswald keeps its headings firm.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans-sc: Oswald brings confident, tightly knit rows of display lettering to the top of the page. Encode Sans SC follows with a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap, professional and quietly steady.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans-semi-conden: Oswald sets confident, tightly knit rows with real display punch, leaving the quieter work to Encode Sans Semi Condensed. Oswald shouts well; the sans keeps its s open and approachable.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans-semi-expand: Oswald is confident and tightly knit. Its strength is bold display impact, while Encode Sans Semi Expanded leaves its rounded letters open and does the neutral, contemporary reading work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-exo: Oswald stands strong, its text rows tightly knit. Up top it grabs attention, and Exo follows with wide gaps that keep even tiny sizes crisp and approachable.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-exo-2: Oswald makes confident display statements in tightly knit rows, with a strength that Exo 2 never tries to match. Exo 2 simply lets daylight fill its curves.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang has a faint nib-pressure shift across each round letter, and its curves finish well before they close, like brushed watercolor. Oswald's tightly knit display rows sit above it, confident where the body is gentle.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-figtree: Confident is the first word for Oswald, whose tightly knit rows hit hard with low modulation. Figtree, drawn like a marker tip with a wide gap in each e, then keeps a long read friendly.
